Workflow demo: how to use it

Made-up pit, toe to interrogated blocks, 19 steps (decision 0065). Built by workflow_demo.py.

1. Open it

Open testdata\synthetic\reserves\workflow demo\Workflow demo.zdp

Click Workflow on the toolbar. The panel lists the 19 steps. Each step shows what it takes, the note on why, and what it made last time 526 made.

2. What's yours, what the workflow makes

Yours (drawn by hand, not steps): the base toe, the pit limit, Block line 0 and the two closing lines. Edit these and run again.

The geology (not steps): the grids and the seam model. The workflow reads them.

The workflow's: everything else, each on a layer numbered in the order it's made:

0pit limit
1toes
2faces
3pit
4strips
5seam pieces
6block lines
7block polygons
8blocks

Green: on show when you open it. The others are a tick away in Layers. That's the answer to "turn everything off to see it": only your lines and the end result show.

3. Try this

  1. Run. Press Run 18 steps. It stops at step 14, the pause: "look at the strips". Tick 4 strips to look, then press Continue from step 15. The same 526 blocks are made again in place, as new revisions of the same blocks. Ctrl+Z takes back each part.
  2. Change the design. Drag the west end of the base toe (Strip 1 on 1 toes) 20 m north. Run, then Continue. The toes, faces, strips and blocks all follow (393 of the 526 blocks change), in under a second.
  3. See a check stop it. Drag Block line 0 30 m east, then press ▶ on step 15 to run from there. Step 18 is refused refused: the polygons no longer cover the pit's west edge, and the cut never runs. Ctrl+Z to put the line back.
  4. Cases. Pick 50m under Cases: the same steps with the block lines 50 m apart (the settings grid shows its two changes in blue: distance 50, times 30). Run it, or Run all 2 cases: Base's blocks on 8 blocks, the 50 m blocks on 8 blocks 50m, each tagged with its case, the same total either way. Type a new case's name and Add, then change any setting in its column.
  5. Make your own. Work a pit by hand. In the Run log, tick the first run, Shift-tick the last, name it, and press Capture as a workflow.

4. Options, and what's built

A
Show a step built Click a step: what it made is selected and zoomed to. "Only this step" hides everything else.
B
Tidy as it runs built A switch so each run shows its inputs and the last step's result, and hides the layers in between.
C
Settings in the panel built The settings grid, under Cases: Base's column is each step's own settings.
D
Cases built, stage 2 Base and 50m side by side, each on its own layers (8 blocks 50m), from one workflow.
E
Report (stage 3) One HTML page a run: volumes, tonnes and qualities by seam, strip and block, and what was left out.
F
Numbered layers by itselfOn capture, offer to put each step's output on a numbered layer, as in this demo.
